rules.statement: Section 55 of the National Savings Bank Act provides that a Certificate of Sale signed by the bank passes valid title to immovable property without the need for a conveyance before a Notary.
rules.supporting_quote: 1. S. 55 of the National Savings Bank Act contains express provisions for the passing of title to immovable property on a Certificate of Sale signed by the Bank. The title bestowed by the Certificate of Sale becomes valid by operation of law. 2. Upon an examination of the provisions of s. 55 it is clear that the legislature has recognised disposition of immovable property otherwise than by conveyance executed before a Notary.
